purpose: Free, traceable match-level xG and independent match-level xGA source audit
rules: Do not replace match-level values with team season averages.
Do not infer xGA from final score or fill missing values with estimates.
Keep source URL, source timestamp/date, match date, home/away team, score, field definition and provider/model identity for each accepted value.

sources_reviewed.name: FootyStats J1 League xG page
sources_reviewed.evidence: The public page has a recent-results section with individual fixture, final score, home xG and away xG. As currently visible, the list covers only a short recent window, from Oct 24 through Nov 1; it does not expose the Oct 17-18 fixtures in the current rendered recent-results list.
sources_reviewed.limitations: Do not extrapolate older match xG from team aggregates. The displayed recent-results values can be transcribed only when the exact match and both xG fields are visible.

sources_reviewed.name: MatchDaySync J1 League 2026-27 shots and xG
sources_reviewed.evidence: The page explicitly says it was restored from an Oct 11 backup and current updates are not connected; its table marks 0 matches for listed teams and has dashes for shots and xG.
sources_reviewed.reason: Stale snapshot with no usable match-level stats shown.

sources_reviewed.name: JPick
sources_reviewed.evidence: The site says its web content is free and its match/player statistics come from SportMonks, but the reviewed page does not demonstrate a publicly accessible per-match xG and separately defined xGA field for each historical J1 fixture.
sources_reviewed.reason: Need match-specific page/API evidence and field definitions before accepting values.

sources_reviewed.name: J.League Data Site official match records
sources_reviewed.evidence: Individual official records show date, score, starters, substitutes, substitution events, shots, corners and match conditions; no xG or xGA field was observed in the reviewed record pages.

result.accepted_free_source_for_recent_match_le: FootyStats, only for exact fixtures whose values are visibly listed
result.policy: Unverified xG/xGA remain null. No team aggregates or estimated values are written into match rows.

next_steps: Continue checking FootyStats recent-result coverage and preserve exact match-level values only where visible.
Inspect JPick/SportMonks free access and documentation for exact J1 historical match xG/xGA fields and usage limits.
Search for another free provider that explicitly exposes historical match-level xGA, rather than assuming xGA equals a separately reported opponent xG.
